constraints: Scope is city-only, Lima, Peru; no venue names, opening hours, distances or prices may appear in this agreement.
Timing is evergreen — no weekday is assumed; the market choice must operate every day.
Dietary needs are unspecified — never assume 'none'.
Access needs are unspecified — never assume 'none'.
Morning through lunch stays in Miraflores, walkable, no leg more than about fifteen minutes on foot from the prior stop.
Exactly one transfer for the whole day, after lunch, Miraflores to Barranco, at most twenty minutes, taxi allowed.
Everything from the afternoon walk onward stays in Barranco on foot, within a few blocks of each other.
No third neighborhood and no crossing back to Miraflores before bed.
No stop may require a return trip to reach the next one.
The market and the afternoon tasting must never become a full meal.
Market stop: browsing and learning ingredients, at most one thing eaten standing up.
Signature lunch: one regional specialty done properly with real time at the table, not a fast in-and-out.
Afternoon tasting: one small portion, roughly twenty to thirty minutes, no table service.
Lunch and dinner venues must each do the regional specialty properly.
The evening dessert/drinks stop must remain genuinely optional — droppable without the day feeling unfinished.
The day overall must stay low-effort and appetite-paced so day two's active opener is not undermined.
Day two should not repeat a market, a tasting, or a culinary-destination dinner.
Nothing is booked or paid for.
